name: Diamonds
description: A regular, non-animated paint that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.
interestingFacts: The paint was released on July 4th, 2022.

It could have been purchased in the shop from a special bundle that came with all 8 Champion paints, 50 Ultra containers, and 240 000 crystals. These paints were specifically for the eSports {GAME} Fund event.
On July 28th, 2022 the paint was renamed from Champion 7 to Diamonds after the legends stage leading into the champions stage.
